La chambre est grande, mais elle fait tellement… vieille.

Cependant, l'eau chaude fonctionne bien.

La chambre est grande et le lit est confortable et moelleux.

Il y a une terrasse (mais sans chaises).

La climatisation fonctionne plutôt bien.

Pas de bouilloire électrique.

On ouvre et ferme la porte avec une clé, pas avec une carte magnétique.

Il faut laisser sa carte magnétique à la réception quand on sort.

Sinon, le réceptionniste vous fusillera du regard.

Le dîner n'est pas un buffet ; chacun se sert.

C'était plutôt bon, même pas mal du tout.

Ils servent ce qu'ils appellent du jus d'orange, dans une bouteille d'un litre.

Mais c'était vraiment bon. Ça ne ressemblait pas à du jus d'orange ; c'était plutôt un mélange d'orange, de carotte et de citron.
Un mauvais acceuil...
Accueil respectueux, service restauration acceptable, les chambres sont un peu a l’ancienne coté matériel et confort, propreté exacte.

⚠️ Worst hotel experience ever — Majestic Hotel Tunis

Unfortunately, I had an extremely disappointing and unprofessional experience at the Majestic Hotel in Tunis.

I had made and paid for a reservation through the Namlatic website, and when I arrived at the hotel, I was told coldly that the hotel was fully booked and that there was no room for me.

What made the situation even worse was the way I was treated by an older man at the front desk. Instead of properly checking and handling my confirmed reservation, I was simply told that there were no rooms available. It appeared that rooms were being accommodated based on personal preference rather than according to confirmed reservations and proper hotel procedures.

I had a confirmed reservation, yet I was effectively left without a room after arriving at the hotel.

This was incredibly frustrating and unacceptable. After traveling and arriving at a hotel with a confirmed booking, the last thing a guest expects is to be told, essentially, “we’re fully booked, no room for you.”

The reservation was eventually cancelled and refunded, but that does not change the fact that the experience was extremely stressful, humiliating and unprofessional.

I strongly recommend that travelers confirm their reservations directly with the hotel before arriving.

For me, this was honestly one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had. 1/5.

Discriminatory and disrespectful treatment

We are a family of three (father, mother, and daughter), and we had a very bad experience at this hotel on (May 1st 2026) Friday night around 9 PM.

The receptionist was extremely rude and made inappropriate remarks that we strongly felt were because we are from Tunisia. We arrived late without Algerian dinars, explained the situation politely, and even offered to leave our passports as a guarantee, but he refused and continued speaking to us in a disrespectful and insulting way.

At one point, we said we might end up sleeping outside, and he responded that he “did not care at all.” Completely unacceptable behavior.

We ended up leaving and booking another hotel at a higher cost, where the staff simply allowed us to bring cash the next morning without any issue—proving that a reasonable solution was possible.

The only positive part was the security staff member, who was kind and tried to help us.

I would strongly advise others to avoid this hotel.
